name: Modal full-window (the desktop shell)
note: THE DESKTOP MODEL: this library component is the shell every desktop onboarding screen sits in; the content inside it is the same 375-wide design mobile uses. Base all desktop onboarding screens on it.

copy: ⚠️ Quiet is in beta and shouldn't be used for activities requiring security.
note: Post-invite-link state of the desktop join flow: Create new account / Recover account, with the beta warning. Shown after an invite link is opened. A 375-wide content component (variant of the 'Join community' set); on desktop it sits inside Modal full-window.

name: Register username
copy: You need a username to send and receive direct messages. Your username will last forever, so choose it well. To support future development, Zbay charges a small fee of 0.025 ZEC, which is approximately $1 USD.
Your username cannot have any spaces or special characters, must be lowercase letters and numbers only.
note: STALE — do not use its copy. This 600x889 component carries old cruft ('New Channel', DM-era wording). Desktop username = the mobile prototype's Choose username content (username-default / username-populated) inside Modal full-window, keeping the app's current validation and parsed-name warning.
